universe: 36,614 scholars with at least 5 works and at least 100 citations in political science journals, 2000-2025

features.label: Fractional citations
features.blurb: Each work's total citations divided by its number of authors, summed across works: a 100-citation paper with four authors contributes 25.

features.label: Solo citations
features.blurb: Total citations to works the scholar wrote alone.

features.label: Solo share
features.blurb: Fraction of the scholar's works that are solo-authored.

features.label: Recency-weighted citations
features.blurb: Fractional citations discounted by the age of the work: a 2025 paper's citations count in full, a 2015 paper's at about a third (x0.9 per year).

features.label: Recent activity
features.blurb: Fraction of the scholar's works published in 2020 or later.

features.label: Outside reach
features.blurb: Fraction of works whose secondary subject classifications reach beyond political science, sociology, and communication.

features.label: Methods citations
features.blurb: Total citations to the scholar's works in methodology venues: Political Analysis, Political Science Research & Methods, Journal of Experimental Political Science, Sociological Methods & Research, and Survey Research Methods.
